name: SAM E54 Xplained Pro (ATSAME54-XPRO)
description: Full evaluation board for the SAME54P20A (120 MHz Cortex-M4F, 1 MB flash) with EDBG debugger, Ethernet, CAN-FD, SD card, USB and Xplained Pro extension headers.
notes: Uses Atmel Xplained Pro extension headers (EXT1-EXT3), not Arduino. Ethernet PHY, CAN transceiver, SD slot and USB host/device features are from the board family description and were not confirmed on a fetched page. Price ranges from about $84 (aggregator) to $113 (DigiKey).
flashMB counts only the 1 MB internal flash (external QSPI flash size not verified). Board size and GPIO count are estimates.
